description_en: Queries instance inspection configurations in batches
description_zh: 批量查询实例巡检配置
name: ListInstanceInspections

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The cursor returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. Keep all filter conditions consistent when querying subsequent pages
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的游标；首次查询不传；翻页须保持所有筛选条件一致
parameters.name: next_token

data.description_en: The list of configured instance diagnosis configurations that you have permissions to access
data.description_zh: 已配置且有权限的实例诊断配置列表

config.description_en: The unified configuration. This parameter is empty if the configuration is not set or is soft-deleted
config.description_zh: 统一配置；未配置或已软删除时为空

items.description_en: The configurations of inspection items. You can configure 1 to 20 items. The templateCode values must be unique. The entire array is replaced during an update. Time-based items use a unified window. The default window for a single run is 24 hours. For periodic runs, the window is overridden by intervalHours
items.description_zh: 巡检项配置；1～20 项，templateCode 不重复，整数组替换；时间类项目使用统一窗口，单次默认 24 小时，周期运行按 intervalHours 覆盖

parameters.description_en: The JSON object of parameters for this item, not a JSON string. The parameters are validated against the parameter catalog. Omitted keys use default values. For time-based items, the lookback value must be unified. The default lookback for a single run is 24 hours. For periodic runs, intervalHours is used. Pass an empty object {} if no parameters are required. Nesting timeWindow or thresholds is not allowed
parameters.description_zh: 本项参数 JSON 对象，非 JSON 字符串；按参数目录校验，省略键使用默认值；时间类项目 lookback 必须统一，单次默认 24h，周期运行使用 intervalHours；无参数传 {}；禁止 timeWindow/thresholds 嵌套
parameters.title_en: 本项参数 JSON 对象，非 JSON 字符串；按参数目录校验，省略键使用默认值；时间类项目 lookback 必须统一，单次默认 24h，周期运行使用 intervalHours；无参数传 {}；禁止 timeWindow/thresholds 嵌套
